notes: Gong is private; no SEC filings, annual reports, press releases or executive quotes with headcount found (tiers 1-3 and 6 empty). LinkedIn member count 2,592 (snippet about 111 days old, roughly June 2026); a different snippet of the same page showed 3,572 members, which could not be reconciled or dated. Older snapshots showed 1,475 and 1,449 members (about 2021-2022). LinkedIn description has no headcount text, so no tier 5 source. ZoomInfo shows only the range 1K-5K employees (not a point figure, excluded from sources). No LinkedIn growth percentages visible. The website tile of 1,500 is undated and likely 1-2 years stale versus 2026 signals clustering around 2,100-2,700 (Revelio 2,101 in March, LinkedIn 2,592, LeadIQ about 2,600 and Tracxn 2,672 in August). Crunchbase, PitchBook and Growjo were not searched. The gong.io/about page was not fetched directly; the figure comes from supplied page context.
